steps.say: Materials have properties. A property tells us what a material is like.
Hard things do not squash. Soft things squash when you press them.

figure.alt: A hard rock and a soft sponge.

steps.say: Rough things feel bumpy. Smooth things feel flat and even.
Shiny things reflect light. Bendy things change shape when you bend them.
A rubber band is stretchy. It gets longer when you pull it.

options.why: A sponge squashes when you press it.

hints: Does it change shape when you press it?
Press your hand into a sponge in your mind.
check.explanation: A sponge is soft. It squashes when we press it.

options.why: A brick looks dull and rough.

hints: Which one can you see yourself in?
check.explanation: A mirror is shiny. It reflects light so well that you can see yourself.
